firmware.title: Prince of Persia
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev; SDLPoP
firmware.description: Prince of Persia, Jordan Mechner's 1989 platformer, on SDLPoP with MIDI music. Sixty minutes to beat Jaffar and save the princess.
firmware.controls: PS/2 or USB keyboard: arrows, Shift: walk/take, Space: time left, Esc: pause.
